# Crates exempt from "a change that edits crates/<crate>/src/ also updates
# crates/<crate>/AGENTS.md", one crate name per line with the documented reason after a `#`.
#
# An exemption is a tracked line, never a silent skip: a reader can see which crate is exempt and
# why, and deleting the line puts the crate back under the rule. Empty today on purpose.
